No further contract extraction; trajectory devolves into terminal-recovery attempts and repeated task-complete submissions. Research effort not sustained or revisited.

reasoning: The agent clearly probed the environment (installed tooling, python version, ports, dependency absence) before building and extracted the main per-subsystem contracts, catching several explicit codes/envelope keys plus a few sharp edges (IRC/web shared seq, file ownership validation, /members/me, polling to survive broadcast-kill) — squarely matching the level-5 anchor with hints toward it.
